entries.title: Dedicated role page modules
added: Dedicated TypeScript page components and role-specific page data for every Organization Admin, Client, and Freelancer dashboard route in the sitemap.
Separate Admin Payments route alongside Escrow.
changed: Replaced the shared role-and-page conditional view with dedicated page components using a reusable presentation frame.
Kept Super Admin and restricted operations consoles outside the three-role scope.

entries.title: Role-based TypeScript frontend
added: Separate Organization Admin, Client, and Freelancer applications under src/roles/.
Direct role routes and role-specific section URLs.
TypeScript configuration, strict type checking, typed navigation, and role workspace views based on the dashboard sitemap.
Visible demo-data label and preview-only workflow actions.
changed: Migrated frontend source and dashboard data from JavaScript/JSX to TypeScript/TSX.
Expanded role navigation for core project and milestone workflows.
Clarified that client milestone approval is separate from settlement authorization.
